name: pulsewatch
description: Pulsewatch — API Monitoring & Incident Management Platform (PERN)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @pulsewatch/server" "npm run dev -w @pulsewatch/worker" "npm run dev -w @pulsewatch/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pulsewatch/shared && npm run build -w @pulsewatch/server && npm run build -w @pulsewatch/worker && npm run build -w @pulsewatch/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pulsewatch/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pulsewatch/server && npm run typecheck -w @pulsewatch/worker && npm run typecheck -w @pulsewatch/client
